title: Iowa vs. UNI (Kinnick)
price: Free to watch at the bar
blurb: Third straight home Saturday. Downtown is a tailgate by 10 a.m.; the Column and Joe's will be at capacity by kickoff.

title: Iowa City Book Festival
blurb: A week of readings, panels and parties across downtown from the UNESCO City of Literature crew. The Prairie Lights events sell out the room.

title: Iowa vs. Ohio State (Kinnick)
price: Free to watch at the bar
blurb: The biggest home game of the year. If you don't have a ticket, get to a bar by noon or watch from Cedar Rapids and thank us later.

title: Iowa vs. Wisconsin (Kinnick)
price: Free to watch at the bar
blurb: Halloween and a home game on the same Saturday. Costumes at the tailgate, costumes at the bar, costumes at 2 a.m.

title: Cedar Rapids Halloween Parade
blurb: The District's Halloween parade rolls through Czech Village and NewBo; the bars on both sides of the bridge stay full after.

title: Iowa vs. Purdue (Kinnick)
price: Free to watch at the bar
blurb: A November home game means cold tailgates and warm bars. The Airliner's rooftop is closed; the pizza isn't.

title: Iowa vs. Nebraska (Kinnick)
price: Free to watch at the bar
blurb: Black Friday football. The whole state is either at Kinnick or at a bar, and the bars open early.

title: Old World Christmas Market
blurb: Czech Village's holiday market at the museum; mulled wine, kolaches and the best excuse to walk 16th Avenue in the cold. Confirm 2026 dates.

title: Five Seasons Lights
blurb: The riverfront light display at McGrath; pair it with Big Grove across the street. Confirm 2026 dates.

title: Trivia night
blurb: Uptown Marion's standing trivia night. Verify the weekday with the bar before you show up with a team.

title: Weekend DJ nights
blurb: Three bars, two levels, a DJ, and 200 tequilas. The late-night option when the Ped Mall bars are a line.

title: Drag and dance nights
blurb: Iowa City's LGBTQ+ club down the alley off Linn. Drag shows, a dance floor, and the friendliest room downtown.

title: Late-night bands
blurb: Big stage, beer garden, bands after 10. The north side's late-night answer.

title: Oktoberfest
blurb: Big Grove goes full Bavaria for the afternoon — lederhosen optional, steins mandatory. Runs noon to 3 PM on the brewery floor.

title: Sundae Sundays
blurb: Big Grove turns every Sunday into an ice cream affair — build-your-own sundaes for the table while the pitchers stay cold. Is it even the weekend without a cherry on top?

title: Vinyl Market
blurb: Flip through crates of records inside the taproom while you drink. Local vendors, cold beer, and the chance to find the one that got away.

title: Puzzled Pint
blurb: Not trivia — a full-on pub puzzle hunt. Teams solve a set of puzzles before the night is up. Love trivia? This is the next level.

title: College Football Watch Parties
blurb: Big Grove opens early on Hawkeye Saturdays with sound up, extra staff on, and the full food menu running. Big screens for every angle.

title: Sundae Sundays
blurb: Sundae Sundays comes to the Solon brewpub — ice cream sundaes for the kids, craft beer for the grown-ups. Perfect end to the weekend.
